rounds.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original logo concept comparison board for an Eastern wisdom daily practice app for international users.
Create ONE beautifully restrained high-resolution landscape board containing EIGHT DISTINCT, ultra-simple seed-based logo candidates, numbered 01 through 08, in a precise 4-column x 2-row grid on a uniform warm ivory background. This is a flat graphic identity design sheet, not a photograph or device mockup.
Brand meaning: Eastern wisdom as roots; daily companionship, consistent habits, awakening from within, patient inner growth and practicing together. Everyone carries inner wisdom. Nurture it daily, grow together.
Core mark: a dormant seed just poised to germinate, NOT a large sprout. Eastern philosophy should be embodied by a soft flowing S-shaped negative space/internal growth vein, recalling yin-yang mutual generation WITHOUT a literal yin-yang fish symbol, dots or black/white diagram. Quiet, inward strength, resilient, timeless, gentle and internationally readable.
Top row candidates 01–04 explore independent inner growth and supportive companionship. Bottom row candidates 05–08 explore shared origin and symbiotic growth. Every candidate MUST remain a SINGLE COMPACT SYMBOL legible as a tiny app icon, using 1–3 broad solid shapes and one generous negative-space curve at most, no tiny root filaments or decorative detail.
01: poised upright seed, two asymmetric broad lobes with an organically bending internal S aperture and a barely suggested germinating tip.
02: quietly tilted almond seed, a single sweeping open seam makes an inward shelter, no extra leaf.
03: rounded seed with two gently supporting silhouettes forming ONE seed envelope, generous central curved growth space, no people pictograms.
04: a compact asymmetrical spiral folded inside a seed-shaped outer silhouette, inspired by generative flow, not a circular whirlpool.
05: two subtle seed-like lobes arising from ONE short shared base, fused into ONE almond silhouette; S shaped shared opening.
06: two nested supporting curved forms with a tiny common-origin space at the foot, ONE seed, no enclosing circle.
07: a single seed formed by complementary rising forms whose shared foundation and open internal passage imply growing together, no explicit roots.
08: a warm, grounded seed contour with one broad continuous inward-returning curve that merges into the shared base, abstract symbiosis.
Use muted jade/blue-grey for the top row, muted ochre/earthy bronze for the bottom row. Pure flat solid inks, no gradients or metallic rendering. All must also work in black and white.
Each cell: one large isolated mark, below it a small monochrome version and a small app-icon application showing THE EXACT SAME mark in ivory on a muted solid rounded-square background. Tiny number label only: 01,02,03,04,05,06,07,08. Small English row captions only: "INNER GROWTH" and "GROW TOGETHER". Plenty of clear whitespace, equal visual scale, crisp smooth edges, professional boutique brand studio presentation.
STRICT exclusions: no lotus, no sun, no halos, no glowing effects, no cosmic stars, no ornate mandalas, no bagua, no religious signs, no full yin-yang, no leaf stems, no trees, no big sprouts, no realistic seeds, no 3D, no hairline ornaments, no gradients, no lettering inside symbols, no invented brand name, no heavy boxes around cells. These are NEW geometrically and conceptually different solutions, not eight minor rotations of the same mark.

rounds.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create an original high-resolution logo comparison sheet, landscape 1536x1024 style composition, warm ivory background, 4 columns by 2 rows of EIGHT distinct minimal symbols. Number each 01–08. No other text.
Brand: overseas Eastern wisdom app about patient daily habits, inner awakening, companionship, growing together. The leading visual MUST BE A DORMANT SEED: grounded, plump, compact, quietly holding potential. Eastern philosophy lives in a subtle generous S-flow negative space suggesting mutual generation; never a full yin-yang diagram.
CRITICAL SHAPE CORRECTION: no flames, no fire, no water drops, no upright teardrop outlines, no long pointed tips, no oil/gas company logo, no big sprout, no leaves-on-stem, no lotus. Every outer mark should be a squat asymmetric rounded OVOID SEED or rounded kernel, slightly wider/heavier at the base, maximum height/width around 1.15, with at most ONE tiny restrained germination notch. It should feel like a whole seed holding wisdom INSIDE, not an open fiery swirl. Make the outer contour soft and full with blunt ends, not spear points. It must not look like a literal photorealistic botanical seed or coffee bean engraving.
Two conceptual families, all deeply simple, one compact icon each:
01 dormant rounded ovoid with ONE wide, beautifully curved S-shaped inner growth aperture, integrated so it feels like a path within a whole seed.
02 a rounded, slightly horizontal seed, one gently curling diagonal growth seam, a barely open notch near upper-right, understated.
03 two softly fitting seed halves nestled together with a generous S passage, their blunt rounded shoulders communicating companionship rather than fire.
04 one folded rounded seed with an off-centre, single broad interior returning curve, less than one full turn, subtle generative spiral, no concentric rings.
05 TWO interlocking rounded seed kernels joined into ONE single squat ovoid, tiny shared base, S-flow gap, no sharp leaf tips.
06 a tiny internal seed shape quietly cradled by ONE broad protective outer kernel shape, two shapes total, common origin conveyed at their joining foot.
07 two rounded complementary growth forms flowing from a single broad shared base, compact oval outer silhouette, one flowing off-centre aperture.
08 a very simple continuous loop folded into a rounded seed, a small open curved passage expressing daily return and patient communal growth, no infinity sign.
Presentation: each cell one generously sized mark in muted blue-grey/jade (top row) or muted ochre/clay bronze (bottom row). Beneath each large mark, show THE EXACT SAME symbol in small solid black and in a tiny ivory-on-solid-color rounded square app-icon application. Both mini applications must exactly match the large mark, not be redesigned. Equal optical weight, broad shapes, crisp clean vector-like edges, no outlines thinner than the main apertures. Professional understated design studio concept board, abundant whitespace. No gradient, texture, light effect, dimensional material, shadows, rendering, mockup scenes, photographs, ornamentation, halos, glows, religious symbols, sunburst, people pictograms, decorative roots, star, letters inside logo, full taiji or bagua. The marks need to remain readable at 32 pixels. Original concepts, not copies of any known logo. All eight designs must differ in underlying construction, not just rotation or color.
